quarterly_data.signal: POET's 20-F: revenue of $1,074,865 in 2025 versus $41,427 in 2024 and $465,777 in 2023, recognized from non-recurring engineering services and product sales; customer deposits of $1,175,000 were received in 2025 and contract liabilities stood at $445,840 at December 31, 2025. Products are typically sold on individual purchase orders without customer commitments beyond firm orders.

POET's 20-F on its optical engines: the 800G receive (Rx) engine is fully qualified and has been designed into the optical transceiver modules of several customers during 2024 and 2025; it sampled its second generation of 400G and 800G transmit (Tx) engines in 2025 as well as Tx and Rx versions of its 1.6T optical engine chipsets. It invested approximately $15.9 million in 2025 in 800G and 1.6T optical engine chipsets and light sources for AI and expects to invest an additional $30 million over the next two years, plus an estimated $8.0 million over the next two years on light source products; it de-prioritized its own optical transceiver modules in 2025 to avoid conflicts with module customers.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G Rx designed in at several customers; ~$15.9 million invested in 2025; additional $30 million over two years; $8.0 million for light sources

quarterly_data.signal: POET's 20-F supplier disclosure: under its fab-light strategy it has agreements with Globetronics Manufacturing, Sdn. Bhd. (GMSB) and NationGate Solution (M) Sdn. Bhd., both in Penang, Malaysia, for optical engine assembly and test; its wafer-level processing production line in the approximately 10,000 square foot Globetronics clean room has the capacity to produce 1 million optical engines annually, and light-source production equipment is being installed in a comparable cleanroom at NationGate. It depends on a limited number of wafer and component suppliers, some sole source, and on contract manufacturers for interposer production. Capital expenditure was $2,310,367 in fiscal 2025 versus $10,378,210 in fiscal 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity 1 million optical engines annually (Globetronics line); fiscal 2025 capex $2,310,367
